# Adscendo

> Adscendo designs and builds websites and apps that help more people find you, trust you and choose you. See our work and how we do it.

Adscendo is the web design and development studio of Jean Menezes. English at /, Portuguese at /pt.

## Pages

- [Home](https://adscendo-site.vercel.app/): Adscendo designs and builds websites and apps that help more people find you, trust you and choose you. See our work and how we do it.
- [Prospector](https://adscendo-site.vercel.app/work/prospector): How Adscendo Prospector, an AI prospecting system with a map, lead analysis, personal emails and a CRM, was built in October 2026.
- [Minha companhia](https://adscendo-site.vercel.app/work/minha-companhia): How Minha companhia, a Brazilian marketplace for families of older adults, went from a screens-only brief to a live product in October 2026.
- [Sidemed](https://adscendo-site.vercel.app/work/sidemed): How Sidemed, a health passport app now used in 17 countries, was conceived, planned and built in-house.
- [Adscendo](https://adscendo-site.vercel.app/work/adscendo): Adscendo is a small web studio led by Jean Menezes. We build clear, fast websites that help American businesses stand out, get found and win more customers.
